name: Context 29
definition: Context in which the card payment transaction is performed.

MerchantCategoryCode.name: Merchant Category Code
MerchantCategoryCode.definition: Category code related to the type of services or goods the merchant provides for the transaction in accordance with ISO 18245.

MerchantCategorySpecificData.name: Merchant Category Specific Data
MerchantCategorySpecificData.definition: Further details about the merchant that is used in with the merchant category code (MCC) for the particular purchase.

OtherMerchantCategory.name: Other Merchant Category
OtherMerchantCategory.definition: Other merchant category assigned by local or national scheme.

POSConditionCode.name: POS Condition Code
POSConditionCode.definition: A code identifying transaction conditions at the point-of-sale or point of service.

NoShow.name: No Show
NoShow.definition: Indicates that the cardholder failed to arrive at the property and was therefore charged a no-show fee; property was not actually rented.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
